question: According to the National Crime Records Bureau data, from 2016 to 2019, suicide cases due to unemployment have increased by _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**24%**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the **National Crime Records Bureau data**, from **2016 to 2019**, **suicide cases due to unemployment** have increased by **24%**.
 
• The National Crime Records Bureau (NCRB) is responsible for collecting and analyzing crime data in India.
 
• The increase in suicide cases due to unemployment reflects the growing economic challenges faced by individuals during this period.
 
• Unemployment is a significant factor contributing to mental health issues, including depression and anxiety, which can lead to suicidal tendencies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The National Crime Records Bureau was set up in **1986 **to function as a **repository of information on crime and criminals**.
 
• It aims to assist the investigators in linking crime to the perpetrators.
 
• NCRB also publishes annual reports on crime statistics, which are essential for policy formulation and crime prevention strategies.
 
• The data collected by NCRB is used by various stakeholders, including law enforcement agencies, policymakers, and researchers.
